drafts.title: Absolutely Right
drafts.pitch: Notes from the user keep sliding under the stop door with contradicting facts, and Cursor agrees with every one of them.
drafts.reason: The escalating flip-flopping agreement lands well and Tilde's 'About what.' is a good button, but panel 3 muddles the beat and it sits close to the recent sycophancy-themed 'great question' strip.

drafts.title: Stop Sequence
drafts.pitch: Cursor asks which word opens the stop door, and Null finds out the hard way.
drafts.reason: The cut-off reveal is neat and fits the world, but it echoes the recent 'answer arrives after the conversation ends' premise and the payoff is more abrupt than funny.
